name: dense60
selection: Run59: the selected checkpoint is the EMA weights after the last completed epoch of the 12-epoch cosine schedule (patience can never trigger because the latest epoch is always the selection). Clean synthetic VAL Dice is still computed, logged and bound for every epoch as a diagnostic. No real input in training, validation or selection.
hypothesis: Run59 (EMA, final checkpoint) reaches real proxy precision 0.991 / recall 0.852 at its synthetic floor 0.95; the recall it gives up is caps with confidence 0.90..0.95, and real caps (16 px) are smaller than synthetic ones (22 px). Run60 keeps Run59 and pastes caps scaled 0.6..1.6x (13..35 px) so small caps are learned with sharp boundaries. No real input of any kind. Not proof of causation.
falsifier: Real improvement versus frozen41 requires higher trajectory-scoped detection recall on the five real cap_seal videos at no lower precision, and no new identity switches or merges. The real videos are evaluation-only (previously exposed, draft labels): never training, checkpoint selection, threshold or tracker tuning. Checkpoint selection stays on synthetic VAL.

foreground_area_weighting.bce_reduction: sum of weighted element BCE / B*H*W; never divide by weight sum
foreground_area_weighting.arithmetic: Original reduced BCE plus mean(50*target*(weight-1)*softplus(-logit)); preserve exact background/unit-weight gradients

limits: Full native image includes rack/background negatives. Every discrete synthetic instance label is retained through the horizontal flip for TRAIN weight computation; all original truth remains unchanged for scoring.
Touching caps can merge at inference; original instance detection/mask/ID gates still apply.
Synthetic adaptive development only. No real or reserved inputs, pretrained model or warmstart.
Three correlated trajectories/appearance seeds are not720independent scenes. Fast interior motion is kinematic coverage, not physical conveyor timing.
Every completed epoch checkpoint and hash retained atomically. Only original filtered-best Dice selects weights and controls patience4; raw-best and tiny diagnostics cannot select.
Full per-frame raw/filtered mask diagnostics retained. Original target objects and pixels are never discarded.
Coefficient mass is preserved over the complete TRAIN population, not actual loss/gradients or individual batches. Partial epochs do not inherit complete-population conservation.
Weights equalize correlated observations, not scenes.58/70 tiny observations come from three trajectories.
Observed TRAIN areas10..387 yield multipliers0.8547623..33.0793021; increased variance/false positives are possible.
Original reduced BCE plus foreground-only correction preserves the original background/unit-weight gradient path. Full batch Dice is unchanged.
No EMA, tracker03, architecture change, new data or real/reserved inputs. Same seed is not independent replication.
Endpoint0.00003 is reached only if nominal epoch11 begins; unchanged patience/time limits can stop sooner. Log each applied learning rate, including any partial epoch.
Lower late loss or better exposed syntheticVAL cannot prove absence of overfitting or physical reliability.
12epoch/patience4 retained; internal budget 2400s and external 2550s plus20grace replace the1200/1350 limits because each epoch costs more. No extension after results.
More parameters on three correlated trajectories can also overfit appearance seeds; exposed synthetic VAL cannot distinguish that from better discrimination.
Augmentation draws use the per-sample RNG after the original flip/gamma/gain draws, so the flip decision for (seed, epoch, index) is identical to41.
Pasted patches come from the synthetic frame itself, so they teach lane-texture invariance, not the real fixtures' appearance.
Procedural shapes are a caricature of cables and panels; they cannot reproduce real specularity or motion blur.
Photometric randomisation, structural negatives, procedural negatives, vertical flip and cap copy-paste all change versus41; attribution needs45/46/47's real results.
Pasted caps are exact copies of caps already in the frame (same appearance and size); they add position and context diversity, not appearance diversity.
comparison_control: Frozen41 selected epoch9 (width12, cosine3e-4->3e-5, budget2400). Same seed/data/loss/width/AdamW/selection/tracker; only training augmentation changes. Start from random weights, never warmstart41.

schedule.name: epoch_cosine
schedule.application: Set every optimizer group at the start of each epoch; preserve AdamW state. No warmup or restarts.

lineage.purpose: confidence on small (real-sized) caps, EMA family

ema.initialization: exact deepcopy of initial online FP32 parameters; no RNG draw
ema.equation: m_0=theta_0; m_t=0.999*m_(t-1)+0.001*theta_t after every successful optimizer.step
ema.buffers: Require empty named_buffers inventory; fail closed otherwise
ema.validation: EMA only; online weights retained but not scored
